content.text: Both files read in full. This change is pure presentational UI: 1. **`diary-grid.tsx`** — Two changes: (a) day-number `` now always uses absolute positioning + fixed font size instead of only when a day is logged, and (b) the streak pill string switches from hard-coded `"days"` to `streak === 1 ? "day" : "days"`. No new sinks touched: no shell/SQL/HTTP/fs/eval, no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, no new URL construction. `streak` and `cell.day` are numbers interpolated as text children (React auto-escapes). The pre-existing `` and `Link href={/outfits/${cell.log.outfitId}}` are unchanged by this diff. 2. **`diary-grid.test.tsx`** — Test file adding one assertion for the singular form. Excluded from review per instructions. No entry points, sinks, authorization checks, parsers, allowlists, registries, or state gates are added or modified. No data-flow path exists from any attacker-influenceable source to any dangerous sink through these changes.
